LanguageData.SSC_HediffFertility_Description: This is the multiplier this condition applies to the body's own fertility. It multiplies with effects from other sources and reflects only this modification's contribution, not the final chance of conception.
LanguageData.SSC_HediffFertility_LactationNote: Switching off milk production only stops milk production; it does not lift the fertility suppression caused by permanent lactation.
LanguageData.SSC_HediffFertility_LactationOverrideNot: Uterine development's fertile mode is enabled, also lifting the fertility suppression caused by permanent lactation.
